name: Ignore code
description: Excludes fenced code blocks (``` … ```) and inline code (`…`) from word and character counts.
author: pan4ratte
label: Ignore code
title: Ignore code
hint:
Off: inline code `…` and code blocks ``` … ``` are counted
On: code is ignored
